phase_statuses.title: Copy audit and replacement
phase_statuses.objective: Identify every English/garbled/informal string in the targeted pages, decide the formal Chinese phrase for each slot (e.g., `Top 5/8/10/15` → `前五名/前八名/前十名/前十五名`), and implement the replacements in the React source so that Next.js outputs clean Chinese characters.
owned_paths: and any shared components those files import).
dependencies: Finalized wording decisions (use existing professional terms from the repo where available) and a Next.js development build for sanity-checking the rendered copy.
deliverables: a short note in `execution-log.md` listing the old vs. new text for each affected area
and a reviewable diff that can be eyeballed in a real browser.
phase_statuses.evidence_expectation: diffs in the committed JSX files and the copy mapping entry in `execution-log.md`.

acceptance_criteria.text: `fronted/src/legacy/App.jsx`, the scheduler dashboard, daily capacity, test tools, and schedule calendar header no longer render English dropdown options, mojibake strings, or casual phrasing; instead they use the formal Chinese text the product already favors (e.g., `前五名/前八名/前十名/前十五名` for the top-n filter, `生产订单数据验证` for the tab, `月历排期` for the header, etc.).

The copy changes are logged in `execution-log.md` with a simple table mapping the previous (garbled/English) text to the new formal Chinese phrase for each page/element so we have traceable documentation for reviewers.

phase_statuses.notes: - Reviewed targeted frontend copy updates and executor evidence; P1 acceptance criteria satisfied.

phase_statuses.title: Real-browser copy validation
phase_statuses.objective: Validate the correctness of the new Chinese copy in Chromium-powered Playwright runs so we can prove that English/garbled text never sneaks back in through stale builds or caching.
owned_paths: plus `execution-log.md` entries capturing commands and evidence (screenshots/videos) generated by Playwright.
dependencies: The Playwright config (`fronted/playwright.config.ts`) to launch the backend + frontend
deliverables: A targeted copy verification spec that checks every navbar item
and button text mentioned in P1
accompanied by Playwright artifacts (screenshots or videos) referenced in `test-report.md`.
phase_statuses.evidence_expectation: Playwright artifacts (HTML/video/screenshot) stored under `fronted/test-results/playwright-*` referenced in `test-report.md`, plus the logged `npm run e2e:playwright` command in `execution-log.md`.

acceptance_criteria.text: A Playwright copy verification spec exercises the sidebar, `SchedulerDashboard`, `DailyCapacity`, `TestToolsPage`, and `ScheduleCalendarPageHeader` to assert the expected Chinese text for every affected element; the spec runs successfully with Chromium in the same environment as the existing e2e suite.

phase_statuses.notes: - Reviewed targeted Playwright copy verification spec and successful real-browser evidence for T1/T2.

goal: 去除前端里的乱码、英文和不正规描述，统一为正式中文表达并完成真实浏览器验证
